def _generate_badge(self, subject, status):
        """
        Generate SVG for one badge via shields.io.

        :param subject: subject; left-hand side of badge
        :type subject: str
        :param status: status; right-hand side of badge
        :type status: str
        :return: badge SVG
        :rtype: str
        """
        return self._get(
            "https://img.shields.io/badge/{subject}-{status}-{color}.svg".format(
                subject=subject, status=status, color=self.color
            )
        )
